summary.text: Karen Gresham is a Democratic candidate for the Arizona House of Representatives, District 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An accountant and former CPA, she has served on the Madison Elementary School District governing board since January 2021.

paragraphs.text: Gresham said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is an accountant and former CPA who audited large corporations.
She was elected to the Madison Elementary School District governing board in 2020 and took office on January 1, 2021; her current term ends January 1, 2029.
She ran for the Arizona House of Representatives in District 4 in 2024 and did not win one of the two seats.
Gresham advanced from the Democratic primary on July 21, 2026, with 51.7 percent of the vote.

In the survey she listed restoring public school funding and increasing accountability around voucher spending, utility costs and housing affordability, and fiscal responsibility in the state budget as key campaign messages.
